notes.title: Voice Chat Is Live!
notes.notes: [p]VOICE CHAT IS LIVE![/p][p]We’re thrilled to introduce proximity‑based voice communication in SeekOut:[/p][p]• Proximity Chat: Only players near you can hear you—stay stealthy or rally your friends!  [/p][p]• Push‑to‑Talk: Take full control of when you speak.  [/p][p]• Custom Audio Settings: Adjust mic sensitivity, speaker volume, and more under Settings → Audio.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646169/beb1de58a4ead733461286eaf8dea3ff2163ac1c.png"][/img][/p][p]Your feedback helps us improve! Head over to the Community Hub or drop a comment below and let us know how it sounds.[/p][p][/p]
